title: Design System Carousel Creator project manifest
description: The root of an isolated project. Everything a run produces lives beside this file, and every stage reads its wiring from here rather than from command-line flags — which is what stops a library being audited against the wrong brief.

creator_version.description: Plugin version that created the project. Migrations key off this.

brand.description: Brand the design system belongs to.

layout.description: Relative paths, so the whole project folder is movable and zippable.

artifacts.description: Where each pipeline artifact lives, relative to the project root. Written by the stage that produces it; read by every stage after.

inputs.description: Frozen at `dscc new`. The library is not reproducible without these, and in six months nobody remembers which brief produced which slides.

constraints.description: Prose constraints made enforceable. Each one maps to a deterministic lint code; anything here is checked on every audit and reported in the scorecard, so a passing gate means something specific about the constraints rather than only about geometry.

independent_cards.description: No card may depend on having read another. Emits CROSS_REFERENCE (P1). The legal fix is to RESTATE the referenced fact on this card — a cross-reference is a card missing content, which is the density law wearing a different hat.

no_source_attribution.description: No title, author, editor, publisher or chapter name anywhere in the artwork. Emits SOURCE_LEAK (P0): one violation is a total failure of this constraint class, not a degradation.

forbidden_terms.description: Case-insensitive literals. Populated automatically from source metadata at `dscc new`, then extended by hand.

forbidden_patterns.description: Python regexes, applied to card text and to the gallery chrome.

required_terms.description: Must appear at least once across the library (a legal line, a handle).

light_is_derived.description: True when the brand specifies only one mode and the other is a derived courtesy variant. Reported at ship time rather than silently presented as designed.

state.description: Pipeline progress. Each stage stamps its own key on success, so `dscc info` can say what is done and what is next without guessing from file mtimes.
